integrity: No claim of novel boundedness/compactness classification; no independent review or experimental proof of infinite-dimensional claims.
scientific_limitations: One variable, real parameters c>1 and 0<tau<1, critical relation only; spectral statement applies to the positive modulus, not the complex spectrum of the nonnormal product. General oscillator-semigroup theory is residual priority risk.
title: A continuous critical modulus spectrum for a reverse Fock composition product
